6f84227 (2026-09-25) adds a buildStart plugin, skipped under Vitest, that runs scripts/translation-knowledge/build-artifacts.mjs --check so a release fails if the shipped translation-knowledge skill artifacts drift. Renderer/main/preload bundling, Electron entries and transcription resource composition are unchanged. 2026-10-28: before a build empties dist-electron/, the config waits on the cross-process build lock in scripts/ui-test-lock.mjs until no Electron UI test in the checkout is using dist/ and dist-electron/ (the config function became async for that); serve, preview and Vitest are unaffected, and bundling, entries and resource composition are unchanged.

Current bytes keep the composition-audited scripts.build change and the 0.3.0 -> 0.3.1 version (see current-composition-audits.json) and add 6f84227's knowledge:artifacts / knowledge:check scripts. Dependencies, the build script and packaging composition are otherwise unchanged. 2026-10-09: the user renamed the unreleased development version 0.3.1 to 0.4.0 because of the scope of changes since 0.3.0; that version string is the only difference from the previously approved bytes. 2026-10-11: adds test:inactive and test:visible scripts, which run the existing test script with a chosen FUSIONKIT_TEST_WINDOW mode; dependencies, the build script and packaging composition are unchanged. 2026-10-13: adds @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.30.1 as a devDependency for the external agent (MCP) endpoint; Vite bundles it into the main process, so runtime dependencies, the build script and packaging composition are unchanged. 2026-10-13 shadcn/ui radix-nova migration: radix-ui ^1.4.3 -> ^1.8.1, react-day-picker ^9.11.1 -> ^10.0.2 with date-fns ^4.4.0 (required by the nova Calendar), and shadcn ^4.21.4 for its Tailwind variants stylesheet. Renderer UI only; the build script, packaging composition and transcription resources are unchanged. 2026-10-14: version 0.4.0 -> 0.5.0 for the 0.5.0 development branch; dependencies, scripts and build configuration are unchanged. 2026-10-17: version 0.5.0 -> 0.5.1 for the 0.5.1 patch branch; dependencies, scripts and build configuration are unchanged. 2026-10-17 easy-setup B4 installer slimming: 39 packages that only the renderer (bundled into dist by Vite) or the build uses move from dependencies to devDependencies with unchanged specifiers, and gpt-tokenizer, which the main process imports, moves too so Vite bundles its o200k encoding into dist-electron instead of packing all its encodings into app.asar; dependencies keep exactly what the main bundle loads at runtime (axios, chardet, electron-updater, iconv-lite, remark-frontmatter, remark-gfm, remark-parse, unified, yauzl, zod). Scripts, the build script, versions, the preload (which bundles everything) and transcription resource composition are unchanged. 2026-10-23 long text translator rewrite: removes chardet, remark-frontmatter, remark-parse and unified from dependencies and @types/mdast from devDependencies; only the deleted old long text translator imported them (the new one detects encodings with iconv-lite and splits Markdown itself). Runtime dependencies are now axios, electron-updater, iconv-lite, remark-gfm, yauzl and zod; scripts, the build script, versions and transcription resource composition are unchanged. 2026-10-25: version 0.5.1 -> 0.5.2 for the 0.5.2 release; dependencies, scripts and build configuration are unchanged.

2026-10-13: lock entries for the @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.30.1 devDependency (external agent MCP endpoint, bundled into the main process by Vite) and its transitive packages; existing resolutions, runtime dependencies and transcription resource composition are unchanged. 2026-10-13: lock entries for the shadcn/ui radix-nova migration (radix-ui 1.8.1, react-day-picker 10, date-fns 4, shadcn 4.21.4 and their transitive packages); renderer UI only, transcription resource composition unchanged. 2026-10-17 easy-setup B4 installer slimming: regenerated with pnpm 8.7.0 (--lockfile-only --offline) for the dependencies -> devDependencies move only: lockfileVersion stays 6.0, the importer entries move between the dependencies and devDependencies sections with identical specifiers and versions, and only packages' dev flags change; no package is added, removed or re-resolved. 2026-10-23 long text translator rewrite: regenerated with pnpm 8.7.0 (--lockfile-only --offline) after removing chardet, remark-frontmatter, remark-parse, unified and @types/mdast; lockfileVersion stays 6.0 and the diff only deletes those importer entries and the packages nothing else needs (chardet, fault, format, mdast-util-frontmatter, micromark-extension-frontmatter, remark-frontmatter); no package is added or re-resolved, and transcription resource composition is unchanged.
